items.hook: 3 từ Traditional Medicine English trong 30 giây

terms.definition: A root used in traditional medicine.
terms.example: Ginseng is a well-known tonic herb.
Store dried herbs away from moisture.

terms.definition: A herbal extract made in alcohol.
terms.example: Take ten drops of the tincture.

items.title: 3 Traditional Medicine English words in 30 seconds: ginseng, dried herb, tincture #Shorts
items.caption:

case.cc: Trễ kinh 7 tuần, đau bụng dưới phải, ra máu
case.says: My period is seven weeks late. I've had a sharp pain low on the right since this morning, and some spotting.

options.vi: Thai trong tử cung bình thường
options.why: Tử cung trống, khối phần phụ, dịch ổ bụng.
βhCG dương tính, siêu âm thấy khối phần phụ.

options.en: The pregnancy is growing outside the womb, in your right tube. This is an ectopic pregnancy, and it may be bleeding.

case.cc: Sưng má trái, đau răng hàm dưới
case.says: My left cheek is swollen and my back tooth is throbbing. I couldn't sleep last night.

options.en: You have an infection at the root of this tooth. It's a dental abscess.

options.why: Sưng má, sốt, có mủ là áp xe.
Nhiễm trùng xuất phát từ chóp răng.
